\begin{highlights}
\item With one open 31B model, the best agent system matches tuned LightGBM on TabReD
\item The harness changes run time and reliability more than it changes mean accuracy
\item An expert instruction file raises accuracy in its own harness and breaks another
\item Agents writing their own code fit one untuned model; AutoML backends search
\item A minimal shell agent beat the authors' baseline on a scientific task in minutes
\end{highlights}
